['T\u00f6nnies Holding ApS & Co. KG '].company_description: Tönnies Holding ApS & Co. KG operates in the meat processing industry, specializing in pig, sow, and beef cattle slaughtering and processing. ['Wieland-Werke AG '].company_description: The Wieland Group is a manufacturer of semi-finished products in copper and copper alloys. The group of companies with Wieland-Werke AG as the ultimate parent company is organized into four business units. Since its foundation, the company’s headquarters has been located in Ulm. The Wieland Group has production sites in Asia, Europe and the USA.
